summary: Adds orderDate column to CRM orders (default today, backfilled), order page shows the date, orders tables show orderDate instead of creation date.

statements.why: Additive column with default and backfill; no logins, money or data loss.

Order date is the UTC creation day and can't be edited; late-evening orders may show neighbouring day.
